summary.name: linked
summary.one_liner: linked is a free, open-source daily journaling app designed to let you record thoughts without distraction.
use_cases: recording thoughts and decluttering the mind
keeping memories and things to remember
organizing events and making sense of the day
offline note taking for a journal
summary.what_it_does: The page presents linked as a distraction-free daily journaling app. Listed features include a markdown-style editor with fenced code blocks, search across entries, offline-first operation, keyboard shortcuts, custom themes, and a minimal design. The developer says the app is free and open source and that user data is not used for payment, with the user keeping control of their data. The page also describes the developer's feature request channel and offers a sponsorship option. Journaling benefits are discussed in general terms, but these are not specific product claims.
notable: Free and open source, with sponsorship offered as optional support
Offline-first with keyboard shortcuts and custom themes
Listed under Markdown apps in an open-source macOS apps list
caveats: Supported platforms are not named on the page; the listing suggests macOS but this is not confirmed in the page text
Feature requests are accepted, so the feature set may change
